description: This file defines the main React component for an OTT match viewer application. It manages state for match details, emoji reactions, theme toggling, and video playback, and renders the user interface including a YouTube video player, emoji reaction buttons, match info, and dynamic emoji animations.

methods.name: App()
methods.description: Main React functional component that encapsulates the OTT match viewer UI and logic.

methods.name: getTeamLogo
methods.description: Helper function to render team logos or placeholder initials.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Function to toggle between light and dark themes.

methods.name: fetchMatchDetails
methods.description: Fetches match data from backend API on component mount.

methods.name: fetchEmojiReactions
methods.description: Polls the backend API for current emoji reactions for the match.

methods.name: handleSendEmoji
methods.description: Handles user clicking an emoji button: animates emoji and sends reaction to backend.

methods.name: animateEmoji
methods.description: Creates a flying emoji animation by adding and removing emoji state entries.
